items.title: Trishna
items.credits: Composed and sung by Nihira Joshi-Deshpande
items.description:
“Trishna” is a bouquet of four songs, that tells Radha’s story and her human longing and divine love for Lord Krishna in different ways. Each ‘Trishna’ is a different chapter in this story.
Each of the four melodies, which were composed and sung by me, are Raga-based. Apoorva Kulkarni, Tejas Ranade and Shashi Sharma have penned the lyrics. Artists from India (Mayukh Sarkar, Saurabh Bhalerao) as well as [Latin Grammy](https://www.latingrammy.com/en) nominated artists from Spain ([Carlos Cano](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2NeSRO4dOnMYN6pU1IkP9N), [Hernán Milla](https://www.hernanmilla.com/)) have arranged and produced the tracks.
The album opens with a poem written by Tejas Ranade and recited by Girija Oak Godbole.
All tracks have been recorded at [Audio Garage Studio](https://www.mumbaimusicinstitute.in/audio-garage/) by Amey Londhe, who has also mixed three of the songs while Dipesh Sharma Batalvi has mixed [Trishna Spandan Ki](https://song.link/TrishnaSpandanKi).
Album artwork has been done by Barun Roy, and the promos and videos have been edited by Siddhesh Sawant.
